examples: Let's create a picture with paint.
We create a castle from sand.

more.def: To make or invent something that did not exist before.
examples: The students created a model of the solar system.
The author created a whole new world in her book.
Wind and water created the shapes in these rocks.
A tiny creature ran under the leaf.
A snail is a slow creature.

more.def: Any living animal, real or imaginary.
examples: Strange creatures live at the bottom of the ocean.
The tide pool was full of tiny sea creatures.
The dragon is a creature found only in stories.
